name: syscribe-lsp
description: LSP client for the Syscribe model format — diagnostics, navigation, completion, and rename over `syscribe lsp`.

syscribe.serverPath.description: Path to the syscribe binary (must be built with the `lsp` subcommand). Leave empty to auto-resolve: `syscribe` on PATH, else a managed copy downloaded from the sjames/syscribe GitHub releases (see syscribe.version).

syscribe.version.description: Release tag (e.g. "v0.37.0") of the managed syscribe binary to download when no syscribe.serverPath is set and no syscribe is found on PATH. "latest" always resolves to the newest GitHub release.

syscribe.modelRoot.description: Model root passed as `-m <path>` (relative to the workspace folder). Leave empty to let the server auto-discover it (--model flag > SYSCRIBE_MODEL env > walk-up to the nearest .syscribe.toml > "model").

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile
